data.one_liner: A ListView where children stack when scrolling with swipe-to-remove support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a specialized ListView widget where children stack at the beginning during scroll operations. It includes item removal functionality supporting swipe directions and callback hooks before and during removal.
use_when: You want a stack-on-scroll list effect for cards or items
You need swipe-to-delete interactions with direction detection
avoid_when: You require a standard linear list or grid view
You do not need stacked scrolling animations
strengths: Supports swipe direction detection for removal callbacks
Easy to integrate into standard widget trees
weaknesses: Very narrow use case limited to stacked list effects
